comparisonDefinition: Matched means consistent with a rule-based recomputation from the commissioner-approved 2025 nominal baseline, marked 2025 draft, supplied tenure evidence, and frozen roster. The initial undrafted season counts as tenure one under the established rule. This check does not certify every historical ownership chain or establish production migration status.

ownershipComparison.source: Public production league records compared with the reviewed bootstrap and permanent pick identities

interpretation: All 111 nominal costs and tenure values agree with the baseline recomputation after normalizing fresh round-one ineligibility. Retained-player costs preserve the approved 2025 nominal baseline; older historical discrepancies remain visible.

Migration 00008 confirms eleven histories supported by positive 2024 fresh-draft records and marked 2025 retention. Migration 00009 applies the already-established undrafted rule to the remaining thirty-six matching histories.

Thirty players went undrafted and unkept in 2025: initial tenure one and nominal 2026 round-thirteen keeper cost. Six players went undrafted and unkept in 2024 and were retained in 2025: tenure two and nominal 2026 round-twelve keeper cost.

Josh Hart and Quentin Grimes match the same six-player setup. The commissioner authorized confirmation for all matching setups; the earlier provisional labels are retained only as historical provenance. Their actual 2025 payments remain rounds twelve and eleven respectively.

Observed status and observed review reasons preserve the October 1 database snapshot. Resolved evidence does not imply deployment: current database verification and migration audit events determine official submission readiness.
